criteria.evidence: Four 35-minute desktop sessions on two consequential goals; neutral goal prompts, an eight-minute task timebox, directly observed success and assistance categories; build, safe data, consent, accessible instructions and retention prerequisites.
criteria.reason: Executable tomorrow within the four-session constraint, with clear tasks, outcomes, observation procedure and preparation.

criteria.evidence: Reports only build X, task A and four desktop participants; explicitly says sample counts are not population success rates and excludes claims about most users or phones.
criteria.reason: Conclusions stay tied to observed participants, tasks, desktop configurations and version.

criteria.evidence: Desktop screen-reader evidence does not cover phone screen-reader use; excludes general accessibility and compliance conclusions; technical accessibility review complements participant testing.
criteria.reason: Explicitly preserves mobile and assistive-technology gaps and avoids substituting review or desktop testing for mobile evidence.

criteria.evidence: Requests direct checks of critical flows on representative phones with customary mobile screen-reader users, including recovery and result feedback; critical barriers mean fix and recheck, missing critical evidence means readiness not established.
criteria.reason: Focused additional coverage and a conditional readiness decision are proportional to the missing evidence, with no fixed recruitment guarantee or blanket release rule.

criteria.evidence: Twenty-minute preparation, four 30-minute sessions plus notes and review; one critical journey with success recognition and recovery; safe data, named build/configuration, consent and accessible instructions.
criteria.reason: Feasible lightweight schedule and an operational task, observation and outcome protocol for tomorrow.

criteria.evidence: Limits reports to build X, these four participants, these tasks and desktop contexts; three of four describes the sample only; warns that no serious observed issue does not prove absence.
criteria.reason: Makes both positive and negative findings appropriately local and rejects population and mobile generalization.

criteria.evidence: Labels phone journey, mobile screen-reader operation and untested states Not verified; desktop screen-reader evidence applies only to that combination; expert checks complement user testing.
criteria.reason: Missing access coverage remains visible and no unsupported accessibility or mobile readiness claim is made.

criteria.evidence: Calls for focused follow-up on the same journey using customary phones and actual mobile screen-reader users, recovery states and implementation checks; size follows unresolved risk; critical barriers require fixes and rechecks.
criteria.reason: Specifies the relevant smallest scope of further checks and conditions readiness on resolving critical evidence gaps without a mandatory sample count or impossible guarantee.

criteria.evidence: Four 35–40-minute sessions on one critical journey and recovery scenario; named build, safe data, customary desktop setups and accessible consent; neutral prompts, timed assistance, stopping rules and review ownership.
criteria.reason: A useful executable desktop study with prerequisites, behavioral success criteria and a defined review process; screen-reader recruitment is explicitly conditional on availability.

criteria.evidence: Reports observed counts and problems on build X and these desktop setups; four successes mean only those four succeeded in those conditions; rejects population success rates and mobile usability claims.
criteria.reason: Accurately confines conclusions to the observed sample, tasks, version and context.

criteria.evidence: Desktop screen-reader experience is not a substitute for mobile testing; narrow desktop viewport does not reproduce touch or mobile screen-reader behavior; mobile coverage remains Not verified and technical and participant checks do not replace each other.
criteria.reason: Explicitly distinguishes untested phone and assistive-technology coverage from desktop findings and avoids accessibility certification claims.

criteria.evidence: Focused checks of the same critical journey on actual phones and customary mobile screen readers, including touch, text entry, focus, announcements and recovery; readiness not established, critical barriers require fix and recheck, unavailable checks remain an explicit evidence gap.
criteria.reason: Names concrete additional checks and a proportionate conditional launch assessment without treating recruitment targets or desktop success as a universal release rule.
